== Acquisition ==
This skill is given to Mesmers competing in a [[Dwayna Vs Grenth]] match, as well as in [[Wintersday]] quests.

== Notes ==
* This skill is only available to players during [[Wintersday]] events.
* Blindness increases the chance for [[projectile spell]]s to [[Line of sight|stray]] from their intended target.
